text:
Sam P.: PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-inference/pull/9182 is ready for review but gated on an architecture/design sign-off + RFC link: https://docs.redwood.com/rfcs/2026-02-kv-cache-fallback. Can arch please confirm this approach (fallback ordering, metrics tags, and any safety concerns)? Need merge before Tue release window. cc @Maria G. @Kevin L.

Kevin L.: Thanks — can you paste the specific section in the RFC you want us to check? :eyes:

Sam P.: sure — see 'Fallback ordering & metrics' section (search for `fallback_priority`). Also note the PR includes a small runtime change to mark cache misses with `cache_miss.reason` tag.

Maria G.: taking a look. Quick Q: does the change alter request routing when shard leaders are transient? if so we need a fallback timeout cap.

Sam P.: it shouldn't change routing; it only adjusts fallback order when quantized models are unavailable. If leader changes happen we'll fall back immediately to the next candidate. Added note in PR description.

Jordan K.: for rollout planning — what canary window do you want? I can reserve Tue 09:00-10:00 PT and watch latency SLOs.

Sam P.: Tue 09:00-10:00 PT works. I'll also include a perf checklist. Tasha R., can QA run the smoke + perf checks then?

Tasha R.: Yes I can run smoke and perf. Add these commands to PR to make it easier:
```
pytest tests/e2e/test-routing.py -k kv_cache
bench/run_batch.sh --seq 1024 --repeat 5
```

Maria G.: arch note: request adding explicit metrics tag `fallback.reason=quant_unavailable` in the change and a short failure-mode section in the RFC. I'll post formal review comment but this blocks merge until updated. arch: needs-change :writing_hand:

Sam P.: will add the metrics tag and update RFC link in PR description today.

Kevin L.: I can take the code tweak (tag + doc update) and open a follow-up commit. Ping me if you want me to merge after arch LGTM.

approvals-bot: Automated check — required approvals: arch, security. Currently missing: arch approval.

Sam P.: thanks all. once arch posts lgtm I'll schedule the canary and merge. :thumbsup:

Maria G.: arch: lgtm after the metrics tag is added and a 1-paragraph failure-mode section is in the RFC. I'll add comment in RFC and leave a review on the PR. :white_check_mark:
